name: cancel-plan rejects a stale document digest and leaves pending state byte-identical

source.assertion:
assert_equals "a stale cancellation CAS leaves pending state byte-identical" \
  "$pending_snapshot" "$(approval_state_snapshot)"

state_before..local/state/oso-code/{repo}.state:
mode=plan
active_slice=none
verify_green=false
plan_approval=pending
plan_approval_digest=d3f0dbd7d1c0f9e0e2ed69b9b3b30a3c1f5e6fbef5db1cf4c7fdc23c4a8e0dcb
plan_approval_session=test-session
plan_snapshot_file={home}/.local/state/oso-code/plans/{repo}/presented-d3f0dbd7d1c0f9e0e2ed69b9b3b30a3c1f5e6fbef5db1cf4c7fdc23c4a8e0dcb.md
plan_current_file={home}/.local/state/oso-code/plans/{repo}/current.md

session=test-session
